chapter: Cage in Louisiana, minstrels and learning fiddle
title: Father's death and mother giving him away
summary: Cage's father died when he was 10; he worked six months to pay on the coffin, and his mother gave him away three times.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: How'd you live if you didn't work? Well, my papa died when I was 10 years old. Oh, I see. And I worked six months for a dollar a month and paid six dollars on his coffin. His coffin cost $11. A sharpshooter. What's the shop you? What's the shop you doing? That little old shop coffin made like a big up here and little old back down there. Just like that don't make them now.
Big up at the top and strong at the bottom. Yeah.
Yeah. Cost $11. Now I worked six months and paid a dollar a month. And my boy. Did you? Did you? Did you? Then mama gave me away three times.
Your mama gave you away three times? She went on and ran off. Yeah.
She wasn't able to take care of her. Yeah. Well, that must have been hard on you. Oh, it was. I got on pretty good because I was always staying with somebody, you know.
